title: Canonical project record
description: One row of data/projects.csv. Identity and baseline commitment only. Everything that changes after the baseline lives in data/project-updates.csv (append-only).

project_id.description: Stable slug. Never change once published.

alternate_names.description: Pipe-separated alias list used for entity resolution.

districts.description: Council district number or 'citywide'. Empty when the source does not state one.

measure_or_fund.description: Funding measure or fund, e.g. 'Measure T (November 2018 GO bond)'.

fund.description: Short lowercase key for filtering, e.g. 'measure-t'. Empty when the source does not tie the project to a fund.

baseline_budget_usd.description: US dollars, no symbols or separators. Empty means NOT REPORTED, never zero.

baseline_budget_label.description: City wording when the source does not give a single number.

promised_completion.description: ISO 8601, year or month precision allowed. Year-only means approximate; the label keeps the original wording.
